import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/dev")
import validate_out, ref
rng = random.Random(7)
for fn in ("hard_case.json", "hard_case2.json", "hard_case3.json", "hard_case4.json", "case_19968.json"):
    obj = json.load(open(fn))
    # add random queries
    svc = obj["services"]
    obj["queries"] = [[rng.choice(svc) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 40))] for _ in range(20)]
    payload = (json.dumps(obj) + "\n").encode()
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    el = time.time() - t0
    t1 = time.time()
    validate_out.validate(out, obj, sample=30, rng=rng)
    print("%s: compile %.2fs, validate %.1fs, states %d, minimal-ok, queries-ok" % (
        fn, el, time.time()-t1, len(out["dfa"]["accept"])))
EOF
